step.label: Två händer, ett kort till platsen

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. A practised card dealer shows a little flourish with both hands. Her hand at the shoe strokes the yellow card out of the window, takes it in her fingers and with a light flick of the wrist tosses it up in front of her. The card rises to the height of her chest, turning end over end in the air, and her other hand lifts from the table and catches it in the air between thumb and fingers. That hand then brings the card down and lays it flat at its place in the middle of the picture, blue face up, where the last frame shows it, lets go, and glides back to rest flat on the table in front of her. The hand that tossed the card settles back on the shoe, as in the last frame. Her eyes follow the card up into the air and down to the table. Both hands work, lightly and surely, with soft, relaxed arms and wrists; she is calm and a little pleased with herself. Only one card moves: a small card, about half as long as her hand, which keeps the size it has in the last frame all the way. Its back is plain solid yellow and its face is solid blue with a small pink cross in the middle and a small red dot in one corner, as the last frame shows it. A yellow card shows in the window of the shoe all the time: as she strokes one out, the next one is already there.
